about.title: User Guide
about.description: Chitchatter is a communication tool designed to make secure and private communication accessible to all. Please [see README](https://github.com/jeremyckahn/chitchatter/blob/develop/README.md) for full project documentation.
about.publicRooms: Public rooms can be joined by **anyone** with room URL. By default, rooms are given a random and unguessable name. You can name your room whatever you'd like, but keep in mind that simpler room names are more guessable by others. For maximum security, consider using default room name.
about.privateRooms: Private rooms can only be joined by peers with a matching password. The password must be mutually agreed upon before joining. If peers submit mismatching passwords, they will be in room but be unable to connect to each other. **No error will be shown** if there is a password mismatch because there is no central arbitrating mechanism by which to detect mismatch.
about.connectToOthers: To connect to others, share room URL with a secure tool such as [Burner Note](https://burnernote.com/) or [Yopass](https://yopass.se/). You will be notified when others join room.
about.peerVerificationDesc: When you connect with a peer, Chitchatter automatically attempts to use [public-key cryptography](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Public-key_cryptography) to verify them. You can see everyone's public keys in peer list. Feel free to share your public key with others (it is not sensitive information) so that they can uniquely identify you.
about.localKeyGeneration: All public and private keys are generated locally. Your private key is never sent to any peer or server.
about.backfillingDesc: Conversation transcripts are erased from local memory as soon as you close page or navigate away from room. Conversations are only ever held in volatile memory and never persisted to any disk by Chitchatter.
about.publicRoomBackfill: When a peer joins a **public** room with participants already in it, new peer will automatically request transcript of conversation that has already taken place from other peers. Once all peers leave room, conversation is completely erased. Peers joining a **private** room will not get conversation transcript backfilled.
about.messageLimit: Chat transcript history is limited to {{limit}} messages for all rooms.
about.markdownSupport: Chat messages support [GitHub-flavored Markdown](https://github.github.com/gfm/) with code syntax highlighting.
about.sendShortcuts: Press `Enter` to send a message. Press `Shift + Enter` to insert a line break. Message size is limited to {{limit}} characters.

roomShare.passwordDescription: Copy URL to this private room containing an indecipherable hash of password. When using this URL, users will not need to enter password themselves.
roomShare.riskWarning: Be careful where and how this URL is shared. Anybody who obtains it can enter the room. The sharing medium must be trusted, as well as all potential recipients of the URL, just as if you were sharing the password itself.
roomShare.hashWarning: By design, password hash does not leave the web browser when this URL is used to access the room. However, web browsers can still independently record the full URL in address history, and may even store the history in the cloud if configured to do so.
roomShare.copyUrlTooltip: Copy room URL. Password required to access room.
roomShare.copyUrlWithPassTooltip: Copy room URL with password. No password entry required to access room.
roomShare.copyWithPassAlert: Private room URL with password copied to clipboard
roomShare.copyWithoutPassAlert: Private room URL without password copied to clipboard
